typingText:
Part of the rock wall overhung the path at one point.

An observatory on the back side of the Moon would be a giant leap for astronomy, but there is a for more important reason to return.

With a full-power observatory in place, that explanation, as well as a better explanation of high-energy astrophysical phenomena throughout the universe, may be available in the years to come.

There is no magic formula explaining our attraction to architecture, construction, destruction, cultures and urbanism.

I don’t read the language here in Beijing, but it is indeed beautiful. If only I didn’t know anything about architecture and urbanism.
